na mo bud+dha badz+ra dha ra ye/zag bral rang bzhin 'dus ma byas pa don dam chos nyid lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i rtsal dang mdangs/ /zag bcas 'gro ba'i 'dus

tei:div.tei:p: na mo bud+dha badz+ra dha ra ye/ zag bral rang bzhin 'dus ma byas pa don dam chos nyid lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i rtsal dang mdangs// zag bcas 'gro ba'i 'dus byas kun rdzob yid kyi dbang por gdod nas las smon ji bzhin gsal ba ni// khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dbang gang 'dul rol par dus med rgyun gyi 'khor lo shar ba nyid// dag gtsang mos gus sems bskyed las 'khrungs brgyud pa'i byin rlabs tshogs gnyis ye shes gnas lugs gzhi la 'khrungs// rab 'byams mtha' yas zhing kun tu// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bgrang yas kyang*// zhing 'di'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa ni// bdag sogs gdul bya'i skyabs kyi mchog /nyid kyi zab gsal dam pa'i chos// gang 'dul der snang mtha' yas pa// brgyud 'dzin paṇa grub tshogs rnams kyis// theg pa gsum du bsdus te spel// nyan thos theg pa'i lta sgom spyod// rnam grangs mang yang snying po'i don// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam// zhi lhag zung 'jug nyams len nyid// theg chen zab mo lta ba dang*// rgya chen spyod pa stong rten 'byung*// smon 'jug sems bskyed tshad med kun// pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'dus// rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras// rgyud sde bzhi drug bskyed rdzogs kun// snying po phyag rdzogs man ngag dang*// yang snying zung 'jug rnal 'byor che// sngar byon mes po bka' drin can// rgya bal paṇa grub che rnams dang*// bod kyi skyes chen lo tsā ba// chos rgyal dad 'bangs bcas pa kun// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// bka' dang de 'brel bstan bcos tshogs// gzhung rgyud khrid dang man ngag bcas// snga bar phyi mar bsgyur cing zhus// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob 'tsho skyes rje// grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma yi// gsar rnying gter kha las 'khrungs pa'i// zab chos nye brgyud dus su smin// rnying ma lam 'bras bka' gdams pa// mar pa bka' brgyud shangs pa dang*// zhi byed sbyor drug rdo rje bsnyen// shing rta brgyad kyi brgyud pa 'khrungs// stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang*// bar gyi dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang*// smad kyi mdo khams sgang drug tu// bstan pa'i rtsa ba zab cing brtan// ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po dang*// gu ru'i lung bzhin sgyu 'phrul gar// rgyal tshab byams mgon chos kyi rje// mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā byon// rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phebs// na ro mai tri la sogs bsten// gdams ngag zab dgu ma lus pa// bod du spyan drangs slob tshogs bskyangs// yang sprul 'gro mgon ras chen dang*// rgyal ba'i dbang po karma ka

/dam tshig gong bu gcig tu brgyud// gdan sa karma rin chen gling*// grub chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan nyid// gong ma g.yung los gtsug tu bkur// sku yi phreng ba brgyad pa ni// kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas 'khrungs// bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong gi /mgar blon rig pa can gyi rgyud// sde dge chos rgyal chen po yis// dbu yi mchod gnas gtsug na 'dzin// mdo sngags rgyud lung man ngag dang*// gzhung lugs rig gnas ma lus pa'i// chu mgo kun phan 'dzam gling rgyan// dpal kun spungs pa'i gdan sa btabs// 7 gong sa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbus// bstan 'dzin skyes chen du ma dang*// thugs yid bstan pa'i rgyan du gcig /mtha' dbus rgyal blon 'bangs bcas bkur// pad+ma'i ljags ldan nyin byed dbang*// 'gro mgon mkhyen kong mchog gsum gyis// bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung la bstod// phrin las tha gru kun tu rgyas// dgon lag brgya dang brgyad cu dang*// dgon phran stong dang rtsa gnyis sogs// chos sde chen po bcu gsum bcas// bod dang bod chen ljongs kun khyab// dus rabs nyi shu'i gzhung gi mthar// 'dus byas chos nyid mi rtag bzhin// gangs ljongs rgyal bstan spyi bye brag /snum zad mar me bzhin du gyur// ston pa'i thugs bskyed tshad med stobs// bstan pa'i phrin las ma rdzogs shing*// gdul bya'i bsod nams ma zad pas// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma shar// spyan ras gzigs dbang thams cad mkhyen// rgyal ba'i dbang po rdo rje 'chang*// rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje rtsal// kho bo'i rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs// sangs rgyas dngos snang chos kyi rjes// so byang sngags kyi gdams pa dang*// zung 'jug man ngag yang zab kun// bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal// gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// skyes chen mkhan slob du ma'i drung*// rig gzhung dbang lung man ngag tshogs// rang blo tshims pa'i bka' drin thob// rgya mtsho chu thigs dpe ji bzhin// 'phags yul byang phyogs dben gnas su// gdan sa dpal spungs shes rab gling*// gong ma'i mdzad rjes bskyang phyir btabs// bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor lo gsum// ngal ba brgya phrag khur khyer te// ltos bcas rjes 'jug lhag bsam can// gdung shugs phyar ba gru 'degs byas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis// de 'dzin bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde// bstan pa gsung rab dam pa'i chos// yang snying dam gtsang brgyud pa nyid// gsung rab bka' dang bstan bcos dang*// rig gnas rgyal rabs chos 'byung sogs// nyams pa gso zhing spel ba ni// bstan 'gro'i don chen yin par mthong*// dpal spungs chos kyi bang mdzod du// bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rig gzhung kun// dus rabs gsar ba'i lag rtsal gyis// phyi mo nyid du par bskrun byas// 'bad brtson lhag bsam zhabs 'degs kun// dpal spungs gsung rab nyams gso khang*// spro bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'gan 'dzin dang*// las byed yongs kyis 'bad de bsgrubs// bzang po'i bya ba 'dir 'brel kun// 'di phyi kun tu dge ba dang*// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir// skyabs gnas dam pas dge legs stsol// gang zhig sngon tshe 'phags mchog kun tu bzang po'i smon lam bzhin// rgyal dang de sras mkhas grub dgongs bcud gsung rab spel ba 'dis// bstan pa rin chen 'di nyid dar rgyas yun du gnas pa dang*// 'gro kun bde ba'i lam bzang mthong ba'i mig tu 'gyur bar shog

/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun rigs drug 'gro ba'i gtsug na babs// tshangs dang brgya byin khyab 'jug la sogs lha yi tshogs kyis sman sprin me tog mdzes pas ljongs kun gtams// skye 'gro yongs kyi sems rgyud gdod nas dag pa'i byin rlabs ye shes bzang po lhun grub nang nas grol// 'jig rten khams kun zag pa med pa'i skal bzang dga' ston rdzogs ldan zhing mchog rtag tu mngon gyur shog /

ces pa 'di nyid 'phags yul gdan sa dpal spungs shes rab rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gsung rab nyams gso khang nas rgyal ba'i bka' dang de 'brel bstan bcos/ mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rab khrid yig /bka' 'bum/ gter chos/ gdangs dbyangs/ gar 'cham/ mchod bzhengs sogs cho ga phyag len/ rig gnas/ rgyal rabs chos 'byung sogs yod do cog ma nyams gong 'phel dang nyams pa sor chud ched par bskrun bgyid rgyu'i thog mar gdan sa chen po shar sde dge dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi par khang dam chos bang mdzod du bzhugs pa'i dpe cha yongs rdzogs par bskrun byed pa'i skabs par byang smon tshig tu 'phags yul gdan sa dpal spungs shes rab rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi byang chub chen po'i gtsug lag khang du kwan ting tā'i si tu pas bod rab byung 17 pa'i shing bya zla 5 tshes 4 ye lo 2005 zla 7 tshes 10 nyin shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel/ shrī bi dza yan+tu/// /
